title: Spouse Additions During a Disability Compensation Temporary Total Rating
content:
For every temporary total month of a Disability Compensation temporary total past-due, the spouse addition is the spouse addition plus the spouse aid-and-attendance addition when a spouse is recorded on the award and the most recent spouse addition is marked as needing aid and attendance; the spouse addition alone when a spouse is recorded and the most recent spouse addition is not so marked; and nothing when no spouse is recorded.

Every addition in a temporary total past-due is taken from the 100 percent tier: the spouse addition is 220.30 and the spouse aid-and-attendance addition 201.41, whatever tier the award otherwise carries. A spouse is recorded when the spouse additions on the award exceed its spouse removals; the most recent spouse addition is the one with the latest effective date.

**Illustrations (hypothetical, 3 temporary total months)**

| Spouse on the award | Each month | Over 3 months |
|---|---|---|
| Recorded, marked as needing aid and attendance | 421.71 | 1265.13 |
| Recorded, not so marked | 220.30 | 660.90 |
| None recorded | Nothing | Nothing |
